SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ACCOUNTING PRINCIPLES GENERALLY ACCEPTED IN THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA REQUIRE MANAGEMENT TO EVALUATE TAX POSITIONS TAKEN BY THE TRAINING TRUST AND RECOGNIZE A TAX LIABILITY IF THE TRAINING TRUST HAS TAKEN A TAX POSITION THAT MORE LIKELY THAN NOT WOULD NOT BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION BY A TAX AUTHORITY. THE TRAINING TRUST IS SUBJECT TO ROUTINE AUDITS BY TAXING JURISDICTIONS; HOWEVER, THERE ARE CURRENTLY NO AUDITS FOR ANY TAX PERIODS IN PROGRESS.
THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES, TRAINING DIRECTOR AND OFFICE MANAGER REVIEWED THE 990 BEFORE IT WAS FILED.
THE GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, DOCUMENT RETENTION AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE AVAILABLE IN THE TRAINING TRUST OFFICE.
